verdict.rationale: Adyen exposes webhooks for transaction status, a Management/Terminal API, and an MCP server letting an LLM/agent interact with the platform via natural language, which supports agent-driven API access. However, there is no explicit evidence of a dedicated Reports/Payouts API or reconciliation-specific endpoint for pulling daily settlement/payout data into a ledger — only a general 'change how you get paid' account setting is mentioned. missing for 10: explicit Payouts/Reports API documentation, evidence of a reconciliation workflow or ledger-matching feature, and independent confirmation that an agent can actually pull payout data end-to-end via MCP or API.
